hero.sub: Quizzivy is the online testing system of Quizzivy English Centre. Students take the tests their teacher assigns on their phone, then see their score, the answers and comments; teachers build tests, mark them and review every attempt.
hero.haveCode: Have a class code from your teacher?
hero.joinExcluded: Codes never use 0, O, 1 or I.

s1.title: Join your class with a code
s1.body: Your teacher sends an 8-character class code or a link. Enter it and you are in your class.

s2.title: Get the tests your teacher assigns
s2.body: New tests show on your first page with when they open and close. Quizzivy reminds you before one closes.

s3.title: Take them on any device
s3.body: Read the test’s rules, then take it on a phone or a laptop. Every answer saves itself.

s4.title: See your results
s4.body: Once marked, you see your score, the answers and your teacher’s comments.

a.title: Listening, reading, blanks, matching and essays in one test
a.body: Teachers build tests from eight kinds of question: one answer, several answers, true/false, true/false/not given, blanks, short answers, matching and essays. A recording plays inside the test, and a reading passage comes with its questions.
a.p1: A recording has the number of plays the teacher sets
a.p2: Questions arranged in parts and by skill
a.p3: A question can carry an image

b.title: Take tests on any device, and lose nothing if the connection drops
b.body: Before you start you read the test’s rules: the time, the number of attempts, when the score comes. A timer runs while you work and every answer is saved at once; if the connection drops, your work saves when it is back.
b.p1: After a reload or a closed tab, you carry on
b.p2: When time runs out, the test is handed in with what you answered
b.p3: The teacher can allow several attempts and keep the best score

c.title: See what you got right and wrong, and what your teacher said
c.body: Choice and blank questions mark themselves. Essays are marked by your teacher on a band, with comments. Quizzivy tells you when a result is ready.
c.p1: The right answers and explanations, when the teacher shows them
c.p2: Filter to the questions you got wrong
c.p3: An essay can be marked criterion by criterion

fair.title: Fair tests for the whole class
fair.sub: Before starting, students read the test’s rules in plain words. During the test Quizzivy records what happens, and the decision is the teacher’s.

i1.title: Fullscreen
i1.body: Leaving the test is recorded. A few seconds away is ignored.

i2.title: No copy, no paste
i2.body: Questions cannot be copied out and answers cannot be pasted in.

i3.title: A warning, not an accusation
i3.body: The teacher chooses: warn the student, flag it for the teacher, or submit the test.

i4.title: Every attempt can be looked at again
i4.body: The start, each time away and the submit are recorded, with the time.

faq.title: Questions
faq.help: No answer here? Call {{phone}} or write to {{mail}}.

q1.q: How do students join a class?
q1.a: The teacher shares an 8-character code or a link. Students enter it on this page or in the app, then sign in or create an account.

q2.q: Can students take tests on a phone?
q2.a: Yes. Tests work on phones, tablets and laptops, and answers save automatically every few seconds.

q3.a: No browser can fully stop it. Quizzivy blocks copy and paste, records every time a student leaves the test, and lets the teacher decide what to do.

q4.q: Can I sign in with Google?
q4.a: Yes, if your centre allows it. You can also use an email and password from your teacher.

q5.q: I forgot my password. What now?
q5.a: Ask your teacher or the centre to reset it. You will get a temporary password and choose a new one when you sign in.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.lead: When you send the consultation form on quizzivy.com, you give us your name and phone number. This page says what we receive, what we use it for, how long we keep it and what your rights are.

s1.label: We receive
s1.text: Your name, your phone number and the three choices you make in the form.

s2.label: We use it to
s2.text: Call you back about courses and arrange a placement test. Nothing else.

s3.label: We keep it for
s3.text: 12 months, then it is deleted automatically.

s4.label: You can
s4.text: Ask to see, correct or delete it, or withdraw your consent, at any time.

privacy.p1a: {{org}} is responsible for what you send through this page.
privacy.p2a: Only what you put in the consultation form:
privacy.p2b3: The courses you are interested in, who the course is for, and the best time to call
privacy.p2b4: The language of the page when you sent it, the time you agreed, and the version of this notice
privacy.p2c: We do not store your IP address or anything about your device with the request. The server holds the IP address in memory for a short time only, to stop the form being sent too many times.
privacy.p3a: So that one of the centre’s advisers can call you back about courses, and arrange a placement test if you want one. We use it for that only: not for advertising, and we do not sell it to anyone.
privacy.p4a: Because you agreed. Before sending the form you tick the box to agree; without the tick the form is not sent. This is the basis under Viet Nam’s Law on Personal Data Protection (Law No. 91/2025/QH15).
privacy.p5t: Who can see it, and where it is kept
privacy.p5a: Only the centre’s advisers and admins can see your request.
privacy.p5b: When a request arrives, the centre gets an email about it. The email has your first name, the courses you are interested in, who the course is for and the best time to call. It does not have your phone number.
privacy.p5c1: Requests are stored on Quizzivy’s server, in Ho Chi Minh City.
privacy.p5c2: Backups are encrypted and kept with Cloudflare.
privacy.p5c3: The email is sent through Resend.
privacy.p5d: Cloudflare and Resend are companies abroad, so the backups and the email may be handled outside Viet Nam.
privacy.p6a: We keep your request for 12 months from the day you send it, and then it is deleted automatically. You can ask us to delete it sooner at any time.
privacy.p7b1: Know what we hold about you
privacy.p7b4: Withdraw your consent, and we will not call you again
privacy.p7c: To use any of these, write to {{mail}} or call {{phone}}.
privacy.p8a: The form asks only about the person sending it. When you ask on behalf of your child, we do not ask for the child’s name, age or anything else about them on this page.
privacy.p9t: When you only visit the page
privacy.p9a: quizzivy.com uses no tracking cookies and no third-party measuring tools. Your browser only remembers the language and the light or dark look you chose, on your own device.
privacy.p10a: This notice is about quizzivy.com and its consultation form. What Quizzivy holds for student and teacher accounts is outside this notice.
privacy.p11a: Each time it changes, the version and the date at the top change with it. Your request is always stored with the version you agreed to.
privacy.p7cMail: To use any of these, write to {{mail}}.
privacy.p7cPhone: To use any of these, call {{phone}}.
